description: Python calculators (compute engines) TWAIN can attach to a driver library. Distinct from configs/discovery_registry.json, which catalogs the driver libraries (ASE, Pymatgen, ...). A calculator provides the physics (energies, electronic structure); the driver library builds the atomic system and orchestrates the run. Discovery selects among these by capability, library compatibility, and PLATFORM REACHABILITY: it plans against the richest platform it can reach (method_discovery.calculator_registry.planning_platform) -- linux-64 when a Docker daemon is available (the runner image), else the host. So a higher-fidelity Linux-only engine (e.g. GPAW on Apple Silicon) IS chosen when Docker is present and its run is routed into the linux-64 container at EXECUTE; without Docker, discovery falls back to the best engine that builds natively on the host (e.g. DFTB+ on osx-arm64).

calculators.name: GPAW
calculators.description: Grid-based projector-augmented-wave DFT code; a native ASE calculator. Full first-principles band structures, densities of states, and band gaps. Highest fidelity here, but conda-forge builds are Python<=3.11 and exist only for linux-64 (no osx-arm64 build).

calculators.name: DFTB+
calculators.description: Density-functional tight-binding code (approximate DFT); driven via ASE's Dftb calculator. Computes band structures / gaps and energies much faster than full DFT, at lower fidelity. Has conda-forge builds for both linux-64 and osx-arm64, so it is the electronic-structure option available on Apple Silicon. The `dftb+` binary provides no python module, so the importable proxy is ASE's wrapper (ase.calculators.dftb); the generated script verifies the binary at run time. Needs Slater-Koster parameter sets (DFTB_PREFIX) to run.

calculators.name: EMT
calculators.description: ASE's built-in effective-medium-theory calculator. Fast, approximate energies/forces for a small set of metals; no electronic-structure properties. Pure Python (runs anywhere ASE runs). Low fidelity -- a last-resort/smoke option.

calculators.name: Quantum ESPRESSO
calculators.description: Plane-wave pseudopotential DFT suite; a full first-principles engine for band structures, band gaps, DOS and forces. Driven via ASE's Espresso calculator. Needs pseudopotential files. Linux-only on conda-forge.

calculators.name: ABINIT
calculators.description: Plane-wave/PAW DFT and many-body code for electronic structure, band gaps, and response properties. Driven via ASE's Abinit calculator. Needs pseudopotentials. Linux-only on conda-forge.

calculators.name: CP2K
calculators.description: Mixed Gaussian/plane-wave DFT code for large-scale electronic structure and ab-initio molecular dynamics. Driven via ASE's CP2K calculator. Linux-only on conda-forge.

calculators.name: NWChem
calculators.description: Ab-initio quantum-chemistry package (DFT, coupled cluster, ...) for molecular energies, gradients and properties. Driven via ASE's NWChem calculator; basis sets bundled.

calculators.name: xtb
calculators.description: Grimme's extended semiempirical tight-binding methods (GFN1/GFN2-xTB), exposed as an ASE calculator by xtb-python. Fast molecular energies/forces/dipoles with built-in parameters -- self-contained, no external data. ASE-compatible with conda-forge builds for both linux-64 and osx-arm64, so it is the lightweight quantum option available on Apple Silicon. (Replaces tblite, whose python bindings cannot coexist with dftbplus in the sim env.)

calculators.name: MatGL
calculators.description: Graph deep-learning models for materials: the M3GNet universal interatomic potential (energies/forces) plus pretrained MEGNet models that PREDICT properties such as band gap and formation energy directly from structure. Self-contained (ships/downloads weights); runs on CPU on any platform.

calculators.name: CHGNet
calculators.description: Universal pretrained graph neural-network interatomic potential (energies, forces, stress, magnetic moments) for the whole periodic table. Self-contained; CPU-friendly on any platform.
